Notice under Section 7 My No.: ATU/LND/04/DO56. Land Ministry’s Ref No. : 4-3/5/2020/HA/24. I hereby give notice under Sub-section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following Land/ Servitude which is required for a public purpose. Particulars of the Land / Servitude to be acquired : An allotment of Land described below depicted in Cadastral Plan No. 820485 prepared by Surveyor General situated at Pahala Athuraliya village in 315 Pahala Athuraliya Grama Niladhari Division in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Athuraliya in Matara District. 01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Idangoda Pansal Waththa; Description: Home Garden, There is Permanent building and Toilet; Extent: 0.0209 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing to appear before me at Athuraliya Divisional Secretariat on 03.04.2024 at 10.00 am and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 25.03.2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
